title: Collections Desk Guidance: Returned Checks and Drafts on Premium Billing Accounts
content:
**The rule the desk applies.** When a check or bank draft on a Premium Billing Accounts arrangement is returned unpaid, the return reverses the payment in full; the months it had paid become unpaid again and the paid-through date moves back accordingly, which may put the account into grace as of the original due date.

**Re-presentment.** On AutoPay and exchange arrangements a returned draft is presented again the arrangement's re-presentment count of times, the re-presentment interval (business days) after the return, before it is treated as returned.

**The returned-payment fee.** A returned check or bank draft is charged the arrangement's returned-payment fee, but no fee is charged:
- when the arrangement's fee is 0.00;
- when the returned-payment fees already charged on the account in the rolling 12 months ending on the date of the return being charged have reached the arrangement's fee cap; or
- when the return was caused by a Cascade or bank processing error.

A fee may be charged only for a return that has not already been charged a fee. Whether a return has already been charged is read from the account's own ledger before the fee is booked: a returned-payment fee on record that names that same return as the item it is for.

**Removal of automatic draft.** When the account's returned payments by EFT or card in the rolling 12 months ending on the date of the latest return reach the arrangement's returns-before-removal count, automatic draft is removed and the account moves to the arrangement named for removal.

**Fee decision table (hypothetical arrangement with fee 25.00 and fee cap 2).**
| Fees already charged in the rolling 12 months | Return caused by a Cascade or bank processing error | This return already charged a fee | Fee booked |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | no | no | 25.00 |
| 1 | no | no | 25.00 |
| 2 | no | no | none (cap reached) |
| 1 | yes | no | none |
| 1 | no | yes | none |

**Hypothetical illustration of removal.** A Cascade Individual AutoPay Monthly account has one draft returned in March and a second returned in July of the same year: the count of returned EFT or card payments in the 12 months ending on the July return reaches 2, so automatic draft is removed and the account moves to Cascade Individual Direct Bill Monthly.
